charge_port.notes: Estimated: Estimated from the GM 2027 changeover: The Charge Port says the 2027 Equinox EV has native NACS (2024-2026 CCS1), and its 2027 Lyriq and Vistiq pages say the same; no page for the 2027 Sierra EV or Silverado EV states the port (gmc.com 403, Charge Port Sierra page silent). Weak: the truck is not confirmed.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: Native NACS port on the 2027 model year charges at Tesla Superchargers without an adapter (The Charge Port pages for Vistiq/Optiq/Equinox EV; Sierra EV inferred from the port estimate). US.
